title: Khelo India Youth Games 2026 Tender Released
indian_angle: This tender release is crucial for the organization of a major national multi-sport event that includes badminton, impacting young Indian athletes.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has released the tender for the upcoming Khelo India Youth Games 2026, signaling the start of preparations for the national event.

title: Junior National Championships Eligibility List Out
indian_angle: The eligibility list for the 49th Junior National Badminton Championships is out, detailing which young Indian talents can compete in this significant domestic event.
summary: BAI has published the eligibility list for the Yonex-Sunrise 49th Junior National Badminton Championships 2026, scheduled to be held in Sikkim from November 14-21.

title: BAI Establishes New Athletes Committee
indian_angle: The formation of the BAI Athletes Committee provides a dedicated platform for Indian badminton players to voice their concerns and contribute to policy-making.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee, aimed at giving players a stronger voice in the sport's governance and welfare.

title: World Junior Championships Coaching Camp Begins
indian_angle: This national coaching camp is vital for preparing India's top junior players for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships, aiming for international success.
summary: A national coaching camp for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 has commenced at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, focusing on preparing India's junior squad.

title: Advanced Coaches Course Held in Guwahati, Raipur
indian_angle: The BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course helps elevate the standard of coaching across India, directly benefiting the development of future Indian badminton players.
summary: The BAI successfully conducted its Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur, from September 14-23, 2026.

title: New 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Events
indian_angle: The adoption of the 3x15 scoring system in junior domestic tournaments will significantly impact how young Indian players train and compete, potentially affecting future performance.
summary: BAI has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age categories.
